## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: When this story is complete, cycle_ledger.py writes entries keyed by (pr_number, commit_sha) for new cycles and reads both v1.1.0 (sha-only) and v1.2.0 (pr+sha) formats via the sentinel-pr_number migration rule documented in dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py docstring.
- DD2: When this story is complete, a contract test reads a v1.1.0-format ledger entry, applies the new keying logic, and asserts no data loss in the v1.2.0 emission. The contract test ships in tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh` exercising the migration contract:

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given: a fixture PR comment containing a v1.1.0 marker (`DSO-Review-Cycle: 1 commit_sha=abc123 findings_hash=h1 tuples=[["x.py","1","c"]]`)
- When: `reconstruct_from_pr_comments(pr_number=42, repo="...")` is invoked
- Then: returned cycles array has one entry with `commit_sha=abc123` AND `pr_number=0` (sentinel) AND `cycle_num=1`

- Given: same v1.1.0 fixture above, plus a new `append_cycle(ledger, "main", pr_number=42, commit_sha="abc123", ...)` call
- When: emission to PR comment is examined
- Then: emitted marker is v1.2.0 format `DSO-Review-Cycle: <hash> pr_number=42 commit_sha=abc123 findings_hash=<h> tuples=<t>` (NOT sentinel pr=0); legacy v1.1.0 entry remains readable.

- Given: a ledger with two entries: legacy v1.1.0 (sentinel pr_number=0, sha=abc123) AND new v1.2.0 (pr_number=42, sha=abc123)
- When: cycle filter queries `(pr_number=42, sha=abc123)`
- Then: returns only the v1.2.0 entry (sentinel does NOT match a specific pr_number once a v1.2.0 entry exists for that PR)
- And: queries `(pr_number=99, sha=abc123)` (a different PR) returns the sentinel entry as the most-recent prior cycle (sentinel matches any pr_number until next-cycle re-key)

The test must fail RED because `_MARKER_RE_V12` does not yet exist and `reconstruct_from_pr_comments` does not yet emit sentinel pr_number=0.

Update `.test-index` with RED marker `[test_cycle_ledger_migration_v11_to_v12]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh
- [ ] Test is initially RED (cycle_ledger v1.2.0 grammar not yet implemented)
  Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_cycle_ledger_migration_v11_to_v12\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Test asserts BOTH the v1.1.0 sentinel-read path AND v1.2.0 write-path
  Verify: grep -q 'pr_number=0' tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh && grep -qE 'pr_number=42|pr_number=[0-9]+' tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
